description: This file defines the EmployeeLicense entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing employee licenses with ORM mappings, getters, and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeLicense
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's license information, mapping to 'ohrm_emp_license' table with ORM annotations, including license details and relationships to Employee and License entities.

methods.name: getLicense
methods.description: Returns the License entity associated with this employee license.

methods.name: setLicense
methods.description: Sets the License entity associated with this employee license.

methods.name: getLicenseNo
methods.description: Returns the license number string, if set.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the license was issued.

methods.name: setLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the license was issued.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the license expires.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this license.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this license.
